provenance.fit_scope: training frames only, fixed translation; held-out frames score fixed poses
provenance.start_scope: previous full-input conditional correction; folds are local jackknife fits
provenance.nuisance_selection: maximum training objective; original local fit retained on ties
provenance.spatial_scope: per-frame fixed preprocessing on train and held-out frames

limitations: Training-only local coordinate searches may miss distant nuisance optima.
Initialization uses the pooled conditional fit; these are not nested validation folds.
Held-out drops need not decrease after training-only nuisance refitting.
Control detection is not accuracy, joint observability or a native verdict.
Dataset calibration is not ground truth; no new audit or default change.
